peripheral.name: DAI0 Pin Buffer
peripheral.description: DAI pins are replaced by a logical interface known as a pin buffer. This three terminal active device is capable of sourcing or sinking output current when its driver is enabled, and passing external input signals when disabled. Each pin has an input, an output, and an enable.
